example_de: Meine Oma erzählt oft vom Krieg.

example_en: Violence is never the solution.

example_en: Political attacks cause death and suffering.

example_en: There are political conflicts between some states.

example_en: The resistance against the government is increasing.

example_en: The political crisis causes turmoil in the country.

example_en: Many people take part in the peaceful protest.

example_en: The disease is no longer an acute threat in our country.

example_en: Ten people die in a terrorist attack in Kabul.

example_en: Because of the civil war many refugees come to Germany.

example_en: They defend themselves against their opponents’ attacks.

example_de: Die Menschen haben Angst vor mehr Attentaten und Terror.
example_en: People are afraid of more assassinations and terror.
